what: building the full `rsd` compiler worker from this archive
why: the standalone `rsd` dispatcher and `procwt` host build under stock Lean 4.14 (`glue/rsd/build.rsd`), but `rsd/rsdc.rsd`'s native compiler closure (`rsdc/RuntimeScope.lean`, `rsc/SourceBundle.lean`) and `rsd/suite.rsd`'s corpus manifest stay repository-side; in a C-only environment without Lean, the runnable compiler and host are the seed recipe plus `glue/host/procwt.c`

what: 9P2000 protocol framing in the C11 host
why: when `devsrv` is `"-"` (or `RSD_PROC_NS` is unset), `procwt` serves `env`, `fs` and `clock` through a self-contained in-process C11 responder (checked against 10 adversarial framing and path-traversal cases); evaluated C 9P servers lacked permissive redistribution licences and the Rust `ninep` server requires `cargo`/`rustc` outside the C-only archive

`rsc` emits legacy `try`/`catch` instructions while pinned `wasmtime` v50.0.1 implements `exnref`/`try_table`; the bootstrap and program recipes translate emitted modules with pinned `wasm-opt --all-features --translate-to-exnref` (Binaryen `version_133`)

what: separate `RMOD1` compilation of `Proc`/`Float` modules and `toString` on `Float`
why: in a C-only shell without Lean, multi-module `Proc` programs strip `^import ` lines in dependency order before invoking `rsdc` (as in the `examples/app04` recipe); `RMOD1` cross-module `Proc` `do`-desugaring, `RMOD1` `Float` type references, and `toString (x : Float)` remain open (`examples/app04/Table.rsd` formats `Float` explicitly)

`glue/std/Files.rsd` (`fRead`) uses a packed binary-tree chunk reader verified on 100,000-line inputs; `lib/Proc9.rsd`'s lower-level `rdAllPGo` retains non-tail continuation accumulation on large multi-chunk reads
the `algorithms` library in `lakefile.lean` reads sources at `../hyper`, a repository-side directory; the shipped `.lean` files are the audited source copy
its imports (`Lib.Exec9Core`, `Lib.Receipt`) are repository-side; the file ships for audit

what: running `Diff.rsd`/`CheckImage.rsd` on `Images.tsv` rows from this archive
why: compiled `img/*.rscm` images stay repository-side under the source-only archive rule
the OCaml reference front end and the repository-side native build worker are outside the archive; the shipped sources and tables are the audit copy

what: the syntax engine's standalone implementation files
why: they ship inside the seed's whole-module source bundles (`bootstrap/seed/stage-14274/sources/`), while the grammar profiles ship at `rsdc/profiles/`
the archive carries the 0.1 table of record (`docs/PERF-RECORD.tsv`); later versions' full tables land when measured on the fixed benchmark host

what: `ExecModel` instance, R-CIC proof kernel, and the Rust-like surface package
why: the compiler chain has no `ExecModel` instance yet (`docs/RELEASE-NOTES.md`), and R-CIC proof checking, Lean front-end compilation, GPU lowering, and the `Rsd.Surface` syntax package are outside 0.4
